deadline.value: Graduate School lists December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 PhD applicants; an older department page cites a January 1 deadline.
deadline.quote: Biomedical Engineering PhD Doctorate Fall 2027 1278 December 1, 2026 December 1, 2026

also.quote: You should obtain this commitment in advance of the January 1st application deadline

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: Do I need the GRE to apply? No, the GRE is no longer required.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the department pages checked

supervisor.value: Applicants are highly recommended to identify and engage with potential faculty mentors before applying.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended for applicants to the doctoral program (and even applicants to the master's program) to identify and engage with potential faculty mentors.

funding.value: Doctoral students receive a tuition scholarship and a competitive TA or RA stipend, conditional on good standing and keeping the assistantship.
funding.quote: Doctoral students receive a tuition scholarship (good for the duration of their studies, as long as they are in “good academic standing” and maintain employment) and a competitive stipend for work as a teaching assistant (TA) or research assistant (RA).

entry_route.value: Students with only a bachelor's degree are admitted and earn an MS on the way; those with a relevant MS can apply with advanced standing if a lab commits to funding them.
entry_route.quote: All new doctoral students (i.e., those with only an undergraduate degree) will get a M.S. degree as part of their course of study towards their Ph.D. degree. | If you have already a relevant M.S. degree, you could apply to the doctoral program with advanced standing.

notes: Advanced standing requires a funding commitment from a BME faculty lab before applying.
